content:
I would like to get as much value as I can from the 5 Origin of Time we all just received, before they expire. This is the "idea", please tell me if it is dogs--t or how to do better.

I only  have 2 Aequor at level PS+12 (Psyche Surge), and  I would rather keep them like that. Issue is, if I now pull like crazy on Aequor to get other units at higher levels before using the Origin of Time on them, I am going to get wasted dupes of those two Awakeners (automatically converted to Rosescripts), which is *bad*. So instead I would:
- Use Origin of Time on those two Awakeners, send them back to the black pool, harvest from them as much material as I can.
- Pull, pull, pull on Aequor.
- Use my remaining 3 Origin of Time on any  Aequor Awakener I don't want, that got the largest number of dupes after pulling.
- Use the obtained resources to reinstate the 2 Aequor Awakeners that I previously melted in the black pool, and bring them back to PS+12
- Use the remaining obtained resources to obtain/upgrade whoever I like.

Would this be a f--k up? Let me know!
thread_title: How to best use the 5 Origin of Time?

content:
Hello there : )

As I understand, unlike WoDs extra awakeners shard give proto fragments instead of scripts.

Either way, if you like your 2 +12 I would absolutely keep them and spend the OoT and your most advanced non-desired mate right before expiry.

Quick reminder : you will eventually want 5 functionnal teams ( that's 19 awakeners ) so you will need to venture outside aequor one way or another
